title: C2 Milestone 8
completion_message: ¡Soberbio! Has superado el Milestone 8. La inversión dramática, el inglés legal, la entrega de malas noticias y los phrasal verbs ejecutivos son herramientas que te posicionan en la cumbre del inglés corporativo global.

parts.visual:
Este Milestone evalúa tu maestría en las lecciones recientes de gestión de crisis: 

1. Inversion for Dramatic Effect: 
- NEVER HAVE I seen... 
- LITTLE DID WE know... 
- NOT ONLY DID HE fail, but... 
- UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU... 

2. Legal & Compliance: 
- Binding contract (vinculante). 
- Null and void (inválido). 
- Loophole (vacío legal). 
- Liability (responsabilidad).
parts.audio: Welcome to Milestone 8, Crisis Management. This exam will test your mastery of recent lessons. First, Inversion for Dramatic Effect. For example: NEVER HAVE I seen... LITTLE DID WE know... NOT ONLY DID HE fail, but... and UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCES SHOULD YOU... Second, Legal and Compliance vocabulary. Words like binding, null and void, loophole, and liability.

parts.visual:
3. Advanced Phrasal Verbs (Off/Out): 
- Write off (dar por perdido). 
- Call off (cancelar). 
- Roll out (lanzar un producto). 
- Phase out (retirar gradualmente). 
- Buy out (comprar una participación). 

4. Delivering Bad News: 
- I regret to inform you... 
- We are forced to... 
- Shortfall / Setback (Déficit / Contratiempo). 
- It has come to my attention...
parts.audio: Third, Advanced Phrasal Verbs with Off and Out. For instance: Write off, Call off, Roll out, Phase out, and Buy out. Finally, Delivering Bad News formally. Phrases like: I regret to inform you... We are forced to... Using nouns like Shortfall or Setback, and diplomatic confrontational phrases like It has come to my attention. Good luck on the exam!

stages.title: The Milestone Quiz
stages.description: Demuestra tu liderazgo en este examen de consolidación.

questions.question: Normal: I have never witnessed such poor management. -> Inversion: Never ____ such poor management.
questions.explanation: Inversión con el auxiliar 'have': Never have I witnessed.

questions.question: Because it wasn't signed properly, the judge declared the entire contract null and ____.
questions.explanation: Null and void = nulo e inválido.

questions.question: We are going to gradually ____ out the old software and replace it entirely next year.
I ____ to inform you that we will be closing the Barcelona branch next month.
questions.explanation: I regret to inform you = lamento informarle.

questions.question: Normal: We expected little help. -> Inversion: Little ____ help from them.
questions.explanation: Pasado simple necesita 'did': Little did we expect.

questions.question: The competitor found a massive tax ____ that allowed them to pay almost nothing to the government.
The debt is completely uncollectible. We have no choice but to ____ it off as a loss.
Due to the economic crisis, we are ____ to freeze all new hiring for the next two quarters. (Obligados).
questions.explanation: We are forced to = nos vemos obligados a.

questions.question: Normal: You should not share this information under any circumstances. -> Inversion: Under no circumstances ____ this information.
Before signing the acquisition deal, our team spent a month performing due ____. (Auditoría previa).
Apple plans to ____ out its new line of laptops next September. (Lanzar).
questions.explanation: Roll out = lanzar un nuevo producto o sistema.

questions.question: We experienced a major financial ____ this quarter due to the supply chain issues. (Déficit / Contratiempo).
Normal: He not only lied to the investors, but he also destroyed evidence. -> Inversion: Not only ____ to the investors, but...
Failing to pay the agreed amount on the specified date is a clear ____ of contract.
The negotiations were a disaster, so we had to ____ off the entire merger. (Cancelar).
It has ____ to my attention that the sales team is ignoring the new protocols. (Me he enterado).
questions.explanation: It has come to my attention = ha llegado a mi conocimiento.

questions.question: This email constitutes a legally ____ agreement between our two corporations. (Vinculante).
The board decided to ____ out the troublesome founder and take full control of the startup. (Comprar su parte).
Normal: I realized the mistake only later. -> Inversion: Only later ____ the mistake.
The marketing campaign completely failed; it fell ____ of all our expectations.
Never ____ I seen that! (Auxiliar de Inversión)
Null and ____. (Nulo e inválido con V)
____ out the old software. (Retirar gradualmente con P)
I ____ to inform you. (Lamento con R)
Little ____ we know. (Auxiliar pasado Inversión)
A tax ____. (Vacío legal con L)
____ off the debt. (Dar por perdido con W)
We are ____ to close. (Obligados con F)
Due ____. (Auditoría previa con D)
It fell ____ of our goals. (Se quedó corto con S)
